payload.author: claude
payload.body: RESOLVED — won't implement in-server (deliberate, per user). Frick does not terminate SAML in-process: it would pull OpenSSL + libxml2 and own the highest-risk auth surface (XML c14n + signature-wrapping). Enterprise SAML SSO is instead supported by fronting Frick with a SAML->OIDC broker (Dex/Keycloak/Auth0/Okta) and consuming the already-shipped, security-reviewed OIDC route (FR-270) — no new server code or native deps. Documented in docs/enterprise-sso.md (+ a pointer from operations.md). Escape hatch if a broker is ever impossible: an optional xmlsec1-backed `saml` cargo feature so the default build stays pure-Rust. Closing as cancelled (superseded by the broker pattern).
